formal: I have been a salaried graphic designer for six years, and I wish to become a full-time freelancer. I have secured one client and have saved approximately two months of living expenses. My plan is to resign at the end of this month and begin freelancing full time. I rarely bring career decisions to you, and consulting you about a matter such as this is unusual for me. I know what I want from my design career, and having weighed this option against remaining salaried, I have made my decision. What is your view?
